args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.2.0.488-beta (draft build 488) for WoW Forever 1.60.1 (game build 71139)

New
- New settings page 'The game's windows' in the side menu, marked with a small orange New pill until you open it. One master switch plus one switch for each group of windows: game menu and macros, character and spellbook, bags and bank, friends and guild, mail and trade, merchants, auction house and trainers, group finder, battlegrounds and arena. A group you switch off goes back to English at once, no reload.
- New tags: a small orange New pill marks a page you have not opened yet and the top of a new section.
- More than 300 more texts of the game's own windows in Persian, written as natural Persian, not word for word: pet stances and commands, character stats and tooltips, PvP ranks (Pariah to High Warlord), honor, reputation and achievement texts, the guild window and guild rank permissions, raid and party, group finder, battlegrounds and arena, the calendar.
- A window label nobody has translated yet (game menu, character, group finder) is now counted in the report on the status page (kind ui), so the next build can add it.
- Combat watch: when a fight ends, the settings that changed during it (our options, chat font and size, module states, a few game settings) are listed in the report line as 'combat :: name :: old > new'. It only reads, it never writes anything.

Changed
- The switch 'The game's windows in Persian' moved from General to the new page.

This build is for testing in game. Nothing of the game is written, and nothing runs in combat.

Everything from 1.1.9 is included.
